page.layout: One printed page, all lines centred: title block at top, short italic dedication-line block, central woodcut with motto beneath, imprint at foot. No margins with text.

l.i: ACCESSIT operi Præfatio de dignitate & unitate
Ecclesiæ, qua docetur, ab eius societate propter aliquorum, qui
in ea versantur, vitia, non temere esse discedendum. Index
item rerum & locorum Scripturæ, quæ hoc libro explicantur.
Ecce agnus ille Dei, qui tollit peccatum mundi.

page.notes: Woodcut between the dedication block and "IESUS": a small engraved vignette of a tree with spreading foliage, a nude figure beside its trunk, a town with a church spire and tower on the right, and animals in the foreground. No printed text in the image. A small mark resembling a lowercase "c" stands in the left margin beside "AUTHORE"; it is unclear whether it is printed or a later pen mark, so it is not transcribed. The ornaments and the "IESUS" line are spaced letters, transcribed as printed. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed.
